name: balm-platform
description: Bay Area Landscaping Materials — unified platform (public site + POS + admin + driver app + CEO portal)

scripts.preinstall: node -e "const a=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(a&&!a.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('This repository installs with pnpm only (package.json packageManager): corepack enable && pnpm install');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.handover:pack: node scripts/verify-handover.mjs && git archive --format=tar.gz -o balm-handover.tar.gz HEAD && echo "Wrote balm-handover.tar.gz (tracked files only — no .env, node_modules, dist, .next, data)."
